_doc: How to find a pose for a scene (docs/design/pose-picking.md). poses: one entry per pose in data/poses.json (same names): desc = what the body does, as seen; ground = what touches the ground (feet, one-knee, seat, front, back, air, feet-hands); hold = hands that can carry a prop as the pose stands; use = story moments (tags below); like = nearest other poses. tags: the story moments, each with the words that call for it in a scene line (word stems, matched at the start of a word). notWords: words that start like a tag word but aren't (Sita, ready …). wanted: poses the scenes ask for that don't exist yet, in the order to make them; until = what to use meanwhile. Angles stay in data/poses.json; this file is only for finding.

stand.note: plain presence; turn the head with look, open the mouth with mouth

bend-low.desc: deep bend from the hips, knees bent, both arms hanging forward toward the ground

crawl.desc: body low and pitched forward, arms reaching ahead to the ground, legs in a long step

crouch-arms-over-head.desc: squatting low, both arms crossed over the head

fall-back.desc: falling onto the back: body tipped back, legs kicked up, arms flung out

fall-headlong.desc: pitching forward head first, arms thrown toward the ground, legs trailing

kneel.desc: one knee down, the other foot forward, body upright, arms bent low in front

leap.desc: mid-air jump forward: front knee high, back leg trailing, arms forward

leap-dive.desc: flying flat, head first, both arms stretched ahead, legs straight behind

leap-reach.desc: jumping up with both arms raised high, legs tucked

lie-front.desc: lying on the belly, head and chest raised on the arms

lunge.desc: very long stride, body driving forward, near arm thrust ahead, far arm back

lunge-sword-low.desc: lunge, near arm low and forward with the sword pointing down and forward, far arm back

lunge-sword-strike.desc: lunge, both hands on the hilt low and forward, sword cutting down ahead (also a club)

lunge-sword-thrust.desc: deep lunge, near arm straight forward with the sword pointing ahead, far arm back

run.desc: running stride, body forward, fists swinging at the sides

run-arms-back.desc: running stride with both arms swept back

run-low.desc: crouched running stride, head down, fists

sit.desc: sitting on the ground, near knee up, far leg out, near arm on the knee

sit-lean-back.desc: sitting leaning back on both hands, legs out in front

stand-arm-over-face.desc: stepping back, near arm raised across the face, far arm out

stand-arms-up-knee-up.desc: both arms up and out, one knee lifted

stand-guard.desc: wide crouched stance, both fists up in front

stand-hand-on-head.desc: standing, near hand on top of the head, far arm down

stand-hands-on-hips.desc: standing upright, both fists on the hips, chest out

stand-lean-back.desc: leaning back from the hips, arms straight down and back

stand-point.desc: standing, near arm straight out pointing forward, far fist down

stand-point-up.desc: standing, near arm straight up pointing at the sky

stand-shoot-bow.desc: side-on stance, far arm straight forward holding the bow upright, near hand drawing the string back to the cheek

stand-shoot-bow-raise.desc: standing, bow raised high in the far hand, near hand above the head drawing the string

stand-shoot-bow-release.desc: standing, far arm forward with the bow tipped, near hand flung back open past the ear (arrow loosed)

stand-stagger-back.desc: stepping back on the far foot, body tipped back, arms out

stand-sword-back.desc: weight on the back leg, near arm swung far back with the sword, far arm forward

stand-sword-behind-head.desc: weight back, both hands behind the head, sword hanging back over the shoulders ready to swing (also a club)

stand-sword-forward.desc: stride, both arms straight forward, sword level at the opponent (also a club)

stand-sword-guard.desc: knees bent, both hands at the waist, sword angled up toward the opponent (also a club)

stand-sword-high.desc: stride, both hands above the head, sword level across the top as a guard (also a club)

stand-sword-hip.desc: stride, both hands at the near hip, sword pointing down and forward (also a club)

stand-sword-overhead.desc: standing in a stride, both hands above the head holding the sword up (also a club)

stand-sword-shoulder.desc: standing in a stride, both hands at the near shoulder, sword pointing up and back over it (also a club)

stand-throw.desc: bent knees, both arms raised and bent back over the head, head tipped back

stand-wind-up.desc: wide stance, near arm swung back behind, far arm out forward

walk.desc: walking step: near leg forward, far leg back on its toes, arms swinging opposite to the legs

walk-passing.desc: walking, the far leg passing the standing near leg, arms close to the body

stand-palms-joined.desc: standing, both forearms up, palms together in front of the chest
stand-palms-joined.until: stand with both arms adjusted (shoulder ~50, elbow ~120, hand in)

kneel-bow.desc: kneeling with the body bowed forward, head low, palms joined or touching the ground

stand-carry-overhead.desc: standing, both arms straight up holding something above the head

stand-pull.desc: leaning back, both arms forward gripping, as in pulling a rope or a person
stand-pull.until: stand-lean-back with both arms adjusted forward

sit-cross-legged.desc: seated upright, legs folded (throne, reading, teaching)

kneel-palms-joined.desc: kneel with the palms together in front of the chest

walk-carry-shoulder.desc: walking with a load on the near shoulder, near hand up holding it
walk-carry-shoulder.until: stand with the near arm adjusted

stand-embrace.desc: both arms forward and bent at chest height, to fold around another figure
stand-embrace.until: stand with both arms forward (shoulder ~70, elbow ~70)

lie-back.desc: lying flat on the back, arms at the sides or one across the chest (sleep, death)

sit-ride.desc: seated astride or on a chariot, legs down, arms forward holding reins or a bow
sit-ride.until: chariot scenes: stand or stand-shoot-bow on the chariot prop (on: chariot); sit for a horse
